permissionsDescribed: one consolidated per-company document_import entitlement, shared by every kind (DocumentImportAvailabilityService._defaultIsEntitled calls DocumentImportAccessService().isEnabled once, kind-independent)
plus the per-kind register CREATE right via ImportDocumentKind.voucherRegister
the intersection filters the chooser, so an unavailable kind is never offered
accessReview.notes: No 'partial import module' claim and no separately-sold legacy key is named. sales_invoice_import, sales_order_import, purchase_order_import and purchase_import_supplier_line_description are all is_customer_visible=false in prod and are NOT declared anywhere in this guide; the guide describes the kinds as things the chooser may or may not offer you, governed by the one document_import contract plus your create rights.
